analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($751.66) vs SMA5/20/50($750.24/$660.49/$615.32): Above short-term, mid-term, and long-term trends.
· Position vs SMA100/200($609.12/$625.42): Strong mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (89.2%) + Current price near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (65.8→71.4) + Entering overbought + Maintaining upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (7.7906→11.7291) + Improving + Strengthening trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $783.33) + Approaching upper band, band width expanding to 37.20%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($743.76) + Basis (Price pattern, SMA-based).
· Swing Resistance ($759.16) + Potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low recovery continues) + Strengthening uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.76x) + Weakening confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + Buy entry on $759.16 resistance breakout, otherwise wait-and-see.
